messages:
oncall_james: seeing a spike of CUDA OOMs on gpool-us-east-2 (nodes 5-8) even though headroom shows ~1.2GB free per GPU. Allocator logs show a bunch of 'reserved blocks' being taken then failed allocations. starting an incident for now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-177500 — CUDA OOMs with apparent reserved-block contention (severity: P2) — responders: oncall_james, sre_kate, eng_miguel.
oncall_james: quick facts: traffic from model: rwd-llama-v2-13b, sequence length 2048, KV cache enabled. Errors started at 14:05 UTC. Some containers repeatedly crash and get restarted by k8s.
sre_kate: logs pls — grabbing from node-5 now.
oncall_james: paste logs: ```
2026-03-15T14:06:12Z runtime: attempt alloc 52428800 bytes
2026-03-15T14:06:12Z allocator: reserved_block_claim failed (reserved=134217728)
2026-03-15T14:06:12Z runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 50MB
2026-03-15T14:06:12Z kv_cache: checkpoint write 0.3s
2026-03-15T14:06:13Z containerd: process exited with code 137
```
eng_miguel: those reserved_block_claim fails look like fragmentation — allocator has reserved large contiguous chunks but free fragmentation prevents new contiguous sub-allocs. headroom metric just sums free bytes across fragments, so it looks like free but can't satisfy large allocation.
infra_anya: confirmed node kernel has no system swap on GPU side (obviously) — but we do have host mem pressure on node-6 around same time. Could be host-side page reclaim causing GPU driver behavior?
sre_kate: customer impact? custsuccess_ryan: seeing 3 customers with increased latency/errors (500s) and 2 jobs retried. I'll surface to affected accounts and set expectation of degraded throughput.
oncall_james: mitigation options I'm trying now in parallel: 1) force KV cache eviction on affected pods to free contiguous GPU blocks 2) reduce REDWOOD_RESERVED_BYTES env on runtime to reduce large reserved slabs 3) drain traffic from pool to fallback smaller model. executing step 1 on node-5.
eng-runtime-bot: Executing cache eviction: `rd runtime cache evict --pool gpool-us-east-2 --model rwd-llama-v2-13b` — started.
eng_miguel: note: eviction will free many small blocks but allocator may still be fragmented; we should also reduce reserved slab size and restart one runtime to let allocator rebuild free list compactly.
oncall_james: performing env tweak on one replica: `kubectl set env deploy/rw-runtime REDWOOD_RESERVED_BYTES=67108864 -n rw-prod` then rolling restart that deployment (replica 3).
infra_anya: scaling down burst instances to create empty GPUs for warm-up of restarted replicas. draining node-7.
sre_kate: after eviction and one restart, node-5 containers stabilized, OOMs stopped for ~3 minutes then flared again on node-6.
eng_miguel: if fragmentation recurs, we should enable the runtime's compact-reserve flag (experimental) which forces periodic compaction of reserved blocks. Command: `rd runtime config set compact_reserve=true --pool gpool-us-east-2` (will cause short pause on compaction).
oncall_james: scheduled the config change to hit a single node first. running compaction on node-6 now.
sre_kate: monitoring metrics: allocator_free_contiguous dropped to 0 at failure times, now recovered after compaction to ~1200MB contiguous.
custsuccess_ryan: sent note to affected customers: short blip, mitigation in progress, will follow up with RCA and ETA for full fix.
eng_miguel: root cause hypothesis: aggressive reserved slab sizing + long-lived KV cache usage for long contexts increases fragmentation; when large contiguous allocations required (e.g., attention buffer at seq 2k) allocator can't satisfy despite total free headroom. Need: smaller reserved slabs, opportunistic compaction, and smarter eviction policy that targets large contiguous regions.
incident-bot: Handoff reminder — oncall shift ends in 40m. Please document actions and handoff to next oncall.
noncall_james: documenting steps taken and will handoff to sre_kate for next 12h watch. Also creating follow-up task to add a metric for contiguous_free_bytes and add auto-evict rule when below threshold.
sre_kate: taking handoff. next steps: 1) promote compact_reserve to pool-wide after validation 2) roll reserved_bytes down across pool with 10% steps 3) add alert `contig_free < 200MB` -> auto-evict first then page.
eng_miguel: I'll open a PR for allocator changes (coalesce-on-free improvement) and add a runtime flag to proactively break large reservations into smaller ones.
custsuccess_ryan: will follow up with customers with timeline and workaround (pin to shorter seq or smaller model).
eng-runtime-bot: note saved to incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-177500 (private).
sre_kate: closing immediate mitigation — OOMs reduced to baseline. keeping monitoring for 2h. handoff complete.
